theme.en: AI Demand Rewires Memory and Interconnects

dek.en: AI infrastructure demand is spreading beyond accelerators into HBM4, dense DDR5, CXL fabrics, high-speed links, and the test equipment needed to power them. Capital is following the same path, from TSMC's 2nm ecosystem to a $230 million-plus challenger round.
dek.zh: AI基础设施需求正从加速器外溢至HBM4、高密度DDR5、CXL互连、高速链路以及配套供电测试设备。资本也沿着同一路径配置，从台积电2nm生态延伸至超过2.3亿美元的新势力融资。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: AI Networking Startups Target Nvidia's NVLink Stronghold
title.zh: AI网络初创公司瞄准Nvidia NVLink腹地

summary.en: Intel spin-off Cornelis Networks and newcomer Delos Data are pitching open interconnect alternatives for scaling AI systems beyond a single rack. The contest matters because cluster performance increasingly depends on the network fabric, giving buyers a reason to seek options outside Nvidia's vertically integrated NVLink stack.
summary.zh: Intel分拆公司Cornelis Networks与新创企业Delos Data正推出开放式互连方案，用于将AI系统扩展到单机架之外。随着网络互连日益决定集群性能，客户也更有动力寻找Nvidia垂直整合NVLink体系之外的选择。

title.en: Nvidia Details Groq 3 LPX for Deterministic Interactive Inference
title.zh: Nvidia详解Groq 3 LPX确定性低延迟推理

summary.en: Nvidia is positioning Groq 3 LPX deterministic execution as a power-efficient engine for highly interactive inference alongside its Vera Rubin platform. The design highlights a growing split between throughput-oriented AI compute and latency-sensitive serving, where predictable token delivery can matter more than peak benchmark performance.
summary.zh: Nvidia将Groq 3 LPX的确定性执行定位为Vera Rubin平台旁侧的高能效交互式推理引擎。该设计凸显AI计算正分化为吞吐量导向与延迟敏感型两类负载；在后者中，可预测的token输出往往比峰值基准性能更重要。

title.en: RTX 5090 Prices Pass $6,000 as Chinese AI Demand Absorbs Supply
title.zh: 中国AI需求吸收供给，RTX 5090价格突破6000美元

summary.en: GeForce RTX 5090 retail prices now start above $6,000 and some listings exceed $9,000, versus Nvidia's original $1,999 launch price. Reports that Chinese AI companies are buying the cards in volume show how constrained accelerator access is redirecting demand into consumer GPUs and distorting that market.
summary.zh: GeForce RTX 5090零售价目前从6000美元以上起步，部分报价超过9000美元，而Nvidia首发定价为1999美元。有报道称中国AI公司正在批量采购这款显卡，显示受限的加速器获取渠道正把需求导向消费级GPU，并扭曲其市场价格。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: MediaTek Accelerates TSMC's 2nm Customer Ramp
title.zh: MediaTek加速进入台积电2nm客户阵列

summary.en: MediaTek is moving into TSMC's 2nm generation as Nvidia and Alphabet also commit funding to the node's ecosystem, according to the report. A broader group of anchor customers lowers utilization risk for TSMC's expensive ramp and indicates that 2nm demand is extending beyond a single flagship buyer.
summary.zh: 据报道，MediaTek正加速进入台积电2nm制程，Nvidia与Alphabet也已向相关生态投入资金。更多核心客户参与可降低台积电高成本爬坡阶段的产能利用率风险，也表明2nm需求并非只依赖单一旗舰客户。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Kioxia Calls a Halt to Data-Center NAND Price Increases
title.zh: Kioxia叫停数据中心NAND涨价

summary.en: Kioxia's chief executive has ordered an end to further NAND price increases for data-center customers. The decision could temper storage-cost inflation just as AI deployments raise capacity demand, while also testing whether other NAND suppliers continue pushing prices higher.
summary.zh: Kioxia首席执行官已下令停止进一步上调数据中心客户的NAND价格。在AI部署推高存储容量需求之际，这一决定可能缓和存储成本通胀，同时也将检验其他NAND供应商是否继续提价。

title.en: Micron Demonstrates a 512 GB DDR5 Module at 9,200 MT/s
title.zh: Micron展示512 GB、9200 MT/s DDR5内存条

summary.en: Micron has demonstrated a 512 GB DDR5 module running at up to 9,200 MT/s, with next-generation Intel and AMD servers able to reach 12 TB using the design. Denser, faster DIMMs reduce slot pressure for memory-heavy AI and agentic workloads, although the report does not provide production timing or pricing.
summary.zh: Micron展示了一款容量512 GB、速率最高9200 MT/s的DDR5内存条，采用该设计的下一代Intel与AMD服务器内存容量可达12 TB。更高密度、更高速的DIMM可缓解AI及智能体工作负载的插槽压力，但报道未给出量产时间与价格。

title.en: SK hynix Begins Shipping 16-Layer HBM4 for Nvidia Rubin
title.zh: SK hynix开始为Nvidia Rubin出货16层HBM4

summary.en: SK hynix is shipping 16-layer HBM4 for Nvidia's Rubin platform, according to the report. Early volume supply strengthens its position in the next accelerator cycle and raises the qualification bar for Micron and Samsung, where stack height, thermals, and yield all compound manufacturing risk.
summary.zh: 据报道，SK hynix已开始为Nvidia Rubin平台出货16层HBM4。率先实现批量供货将巩固其在下一轮加速器周期中的地位，也为Micron和Samsung抬高认证门槛，因为堆叠层数、散热与良率会共同放大制造风险。

title.en: Astera Labs Extends CXL Memory from Servers to AI Fabrics
title.zh: Astera Labs把CXL内存从服务器扩展至AI互连网络

summary.en: Astera Labs has launched Leo 2 memory controllers with CXL 3.2 and PCIe Gen6 support, plus Leo X for attaching memory expanders directly to AI-accelerator fabrics. The move pushes pooled memory toward rack scale, where capacity can be allocated across accelerators instead of remaining stranded behind individual host CPUs.
summary.zh: Astera Labs发布支持CXL 3.2与PCIe Gen6的Leo 2内存控制器，并推出可将内存扩展器直接接入AI加速器互连网络的Leo X。该方案把池化内存推进到机架级，使容量能够在多个加速器间分配，而不再被锁在单个主机CPU之后。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Tektronix Builds Regenerative Test System for 800-V AI Data Centers
title.zh: Tektronix推出面向800 V AI数据中心的回馈式测试系统

summary.en: Tektronix introduced the EA-ELR 21000 Dynamic Test System to validate emerging ±400-V and 800-V DC power architectures in AI data centers. Its auto-ranging electronic load can emulate rapid demand changes and return absorbed energy to the grid, reducing the heat and operating cost of high-power validation.
summary.zh: Tektronix推出EA-ELR 21000动态测试系统，用于验证AI数据中心新兴的±400 V与800 V直流供电架构。其自动量程电子负载可模拟快速变化的功率需求，并把吸收的能量回馈电网，从而降低大功率验证过程中的散热与运行成本。

title.en: Photoresist Bake Conditions Emerge as a DUV Stochastics Lever
title.zh: 光刻胶烘烤条件成为DUV随机缺陷控制变量

summary.en: A new analysis examines how photoresist bake conditions affect stochastic behavior in 193-nm ArF immersion lithography. The work matters because DUV multipatterning remains central to advanced manufacturing, and small process-window changes can translate into defectivity and yield differences across repeated patterning steps.
summary.zh: 一项新分析研究了光刻胶烘烤条件如何影响193 nm ArF浸没式光刻中的随机效应。DUV多重图形化仍是先进制造的关键环节，微小的工艺窗口变化会在重复曝光步骤中累积，最终影响缺陷率与良率。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Korean Industry Group Quantifies China's Memory Catch-Up
title.zh: 韩国行业协会量化中国存储技术追赶速度

summary.en: The Korea Semiconductor Industry Association estimates that China's YMTC is about one year behind leading NAND technology, while CXMT trails by roughly two years in DRAM and three years in HBM. The assessment, down from an earlier gap of about five years, adds urgency to Korean technology policy and complicates assumptions that controls alone can preserve a durable memory lead.
summary.zh: 韩国半导体产业协会估计，中国YMTC在NAND技术上落后领先水平约1年，CXMT在DRAM与HBM上分别落后约2年和3年。相比此前约5年的差距，这一评估将加大韩国技术政策的紧迫感，也削弱了单靠管制即可长期维持存储领先优势的假设。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Euclyd Raises More Than $230 Million for Agent-Focused AI Chips
title.zh: Euclyd融资超过2.3亿美元，开发面向AI智能体的芯片

summary.en: Euclyd has raised more than $230 million to develop chips aimed at AI-agent workloads. The size of the round gives the company enough capital to pursue costly silicon development and suggests investors see an opening for architectures tuned to sustained, interactive inference rather than only large training runs.
summary.zh: Euclyd已融资超过2.3亿美元，用于开发面向AI智能体工作负载的芯片。这一融资规模足以支撑高成本的芯片研发，也表明投资者看到了面向持续交互式推理、而非只服务大型训练任务的架构机会。

theme.en: Inference Efficiency Moves Into the Memory Path
theme.zh: 推理效率优化深入存储路径

dek.en: This reading queue concentrates on the cost of moving state: KV-cache reuse, weight offloading, visual-token budgets, on-chip links, and encrypted-inference traffic. A 2D CFET thermal study and a field-ready NV-diamond sensor broaden the hardware view.
dek.zh: 本期论文集中关注状态搬运成本，包括KV-cache复用、权重卸载、视觉token预算、片上链路与加密推理流量。2D CFET热设计研究与可现场部署的NV金刚石传感器则扩展了硬件视野。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: AI-Guided Electrothermal Design for 2D CFETs
title.zh: AI辅助的2D CFET电热协同设计

papers.authors: M.-H. Kim, K. Sharma, S. Zhang, et al.

summary.en: An AI-agent workflow proposes a redistributed source interconnect and a substrate-directed heat-removal path for a modeled 12-nm 2D CFET inverter. Together they reduce peak temperature rise by 1.67 K at fixed metal volume and 20 μW; a resistance sensitivity study finds about 0.6 K of cooling with a 2% nFET on-current penalty. The result is an electrothermal-model study rather than measured silicon, so the main contribution is the constrained design-and-verification workflow, not proof of manufacturability.
summary.zh: 该研究让AI智能体为一个12 nm 2D CFET反相器模型提出重新分配的源极互连，以及面向衬底的散热路径。在金属体积与20 μW功耗不变时，组合设计把峰值温升降低1.67 K；电阻敏感性分析还显示，可用2%的nFET导通电流损失换取约0.6 K降温。结果来自电热模型而非实测硅片，因此主要贡献是受约束的设计与验证流程，而非可制造性的证明。

title.en: Circuits & Architecture
title.zh: 电路与架构

title.en: Budgeted Express-Mesh Co-Designs Links and Adaptive Routing
title.zh: Budgeted Express-Mesh协同设计链路与自适应路由

summary.en: Budgeted Express-Mesh adds a limited number of traffic-aware express links under a fixed wiring budget, then jointly selects their placement and deadlock-free adaptive routes. Simulations across four synthetic workloads improve high-load throughput over a conventional mesh and random link placement, with gains persisting under delayed quantized congestion signals and longer link latency. The evidence is simulation-only and workload-sensitive, so area, timing, and physical-design costs remain open.
summary.zh: Budgeted Express-Mesh在固定布线预算下加入少量流量感知的快速链路，并协同优化链路位置与无死锁自适应路由。对4种合成负载的仿真显示，其高负载吞吐量优于传统Mesh和随机链路布局；在量化拥塞信号延迟与链路时延增加时，优势仍然存在。现有证据仅来自仿真且依赖负载，面积、时序与物理设计成本仍待验证。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: OptiPrime Co-Designs Protocols and Hardware for Private Inference
title.zh: OptiPrime协同优化隐私推理协议与硬件

papers.authors: J. Yu, Y. Yu, S. Chen, et al.

summary.en: OptiPrime attacks a system bottleneck that remains after homomorphic-encryption accelerators speed up individual operations: repeated wireless transfer of input and output ciphertexts in HE-MPC inference. Its convolution protocol reduces output ciphertext traffic, while the hardware design is reorganized for the resulting weight-plaintext and intermediate-ciphertext memory pressure. The preprint usefully shifts evaluation from isolated crypto kernels to end-to-end inference, but broader network and model coverage will be needed to establish generality.
summary.zh: OptiPrime针对同态加密加速器提升单项运算后仍然存在的系统瓶颈：HE-MPC推理中输入与输出密文的反复无线传输。其卷积协议减少输出密文流量，同时重新组织硬件，以应对由权重明文和中间密文带来的内存访问压力。该预印本把评估重点从孤立的密码学内核转向端到端推理，但仍需覆盖更多网络环境与模型才能证明普适性。

title.en: AI Research & Inference Systems
title.zh: AI研究与推理系统

title.en: Reusing Shared-Prefix KV Caches Across Standard LoRA Adapters
title.zh: 在标准LoRA适配器之间复用共享前缀KV Cache

summary.en: The paper tests whether one backbone prefill KV cache can be reused across already-trained LoRA specialists instead of recomputing a shared context for each adapter. On Qwen3-1.7B with HotpotQA and GSM8K adapters, full-prefix reuse minimizes prefill cost but changes GSM8K exact match by -4.6 points at a 160-token budget, -3.0 at 320 tokens, and -0.8 under a second seed. Partial recomputation shows no demonstrated advantage, and the limited model-task sweep does not establish quality equivalence or a universal handoff boundary.
summary.zh: 论文测试能否在多个已训练LoRA专家之间复用一次骨干模型的前缀KV Cache，从而避免为每个适配器重复计算相同上下文。在搭载HotpotQA与GSM8K适配器的Qwen3-1.7B上，全前缀复用把预填充成本降到最低，但GSM8K精确匹配率在160-token预算下变化-4.6个百分点、320-token下为-3.0，第二个随机种子下为-0.8。局部重算未显示优势，而有限的模型与任务范围也不足以证明质量等价或给出通用切换边界。

title.en: FlexEE Makes Early Exit Compatible with KV Caches and Weight Offloading
title.zh: FlexEE让提前退出兼容KV Cache与权重卸载

papers.authors: Q. Xie, Z. Li, Y. Kang

summary.en: FlexEE combines layer-wise exit supervision, self-speculative decoding over a local Top-K vocabulary, and dynamic hidden-state management so early exits remain KV-cache correct. It reports up to 1.27× and 3.16× end-to-end speedups on Llama2-7B at 0% and 50% weight offloading, and 1.25× and 2.83× on Llama3-8B, with minimal stated accuracy loss. The largest gains arrive in offloaded settings, so performance on fully resident production accelerators needs separate validation.
summary.zh: FlexEE结合逐层退出监督、局部Top-K词表上的自推测解码，以及动态隐藏状态管理，使提前退出仍能保持KV Cache正确。论文报告称，Llama2-7B在0%与50%权重卸载时端到端最高加速分别为1.27×和3.16×，Llama3-8B则为1.25×和2.83×，且准确率损失很小。最大收益出现在权重卸载场景，因此仍需单独验证模型完全驻留于生产加速器时的表现。

title.en: StackTok Adapts Visual-Token Selection to Query and Budget
title.zh: StackTok按查询与预算自适应筛选视觉token

papers.authors: Z. Wang, L. Zhang, L. Wang, et al.

summary.en: StackTok is a training-free visual-token selector that adjusts the balance between query relevance and image coverage according to the token budget and query-vision affinity. For high-resolution images, it also allocates a shared budget across crops using marginal gains from locally nominated tokens. Evaluation spans five VLMs and ten image-understanding benchmarks, but the preprint still needs deployment-level latency and memory measurements to show how token savings translate into hardware gains.
summary.zh: StackTok是一种无需训练的视觉token筛选器，会根据token预算及查询与图像的相关性，自适应平衡查询相关度和画面覆盖度。对于高分辨率图像，它还依据各裁剪区域候选token的边际收益分配统一预算。论文覆盖5个VLM与10项图像理解基准，但仍需部署级延迟与内存测量，才能说明token节省能转化为多大硬件收益。

title.en: Quantum Devices & Systems
title.zh: 量子器件与系统

title.en: Portable NV-Diamond Magnetometer Reaches Shot-Noise-Limited Operation
title.zh: 便携式NV金刚石磁力计达到散粒噪声极限

papers.authors: A. K. P, V. Rane, S. Atakar, et al.

summary.en: A portable ensemble NV-diamond magnetometer combines dynamic differential readout, in-situ lineshape tracking, and a magnetic eigenvector transform to suppress laser noise and thermal drift. In unshielded conditions it reaches an off-resonance noise factor of 1.0 ± 0.1 and cuts long-term drift tenfold. That moves vector quantum sensing closer to field use, although durability and calibration stability outside the reported setup remain to be demonstrated.
summary.zh: 一款便携式系综NV金刚石磁力计结合动态差分读出、原位线形跟踪与磁本征向量变换，用于抑制激光噪声和温度漂移。在无磁屏蔽环境下，系统实现1.0 ± 0.1的离共振噪声因子，并把长期漂移降低10倍。该结果让矢量量子传感更接近现场应用，但在所报告装置之外的耐久性与校准稳定性仍待证明。
